observation.visible_scene: A sunny beach: rippled sand with footprints in the foreground, calm sea to the left, a tree-covered headland on the right, blue sky with thin clouds and a strong sun flare at upper right. A single distant person stands at the waterline with both arms raised, holding a thin line/wand, surrounded by a dense cloud of soap bubbles. Many small glittering bubbles fill the sky, and several large iridescent bubbles float close to the camera.
visible_changes: The camera and background (headland, trees, sun flare, footprint pattern, distant person's position near frame center) stay fixed throughout, so observed motion is bubble motion, not camera motion.
The distant person remains standing with arms outstretched in roughly the same pose from first to last frame; no clear walking or large gesture is visible within the segment.
The cluster of large iridescent bubbles on the right side (present at t=0.000 near mid-right) drifts rightward and slightly upward, growing then leaving the frame by about t=1.6-1.8.
A dome-shaped bubble resting on the sand near the person appears around t=0.4-0.6, enlarges and shifts rightward across the mid frames, and exits the right edge by about t=1.6-1.8.
A large bubble on the left side becomes visible in the later half (around t=1.8-2.0), drifts leftward, and leaves the left edge by about t=2.2-2.4.
Large bubbles at the top of the frame drift upward and out of view.
The fine field of small sparkle bubbles persists across the whole segment, continuously shifting in position and density without a clear start or end.
No popping event, no landing impact, and no completion of the bubble stream is observed; the bubble flow is already ongoing at the first frame and still ongoing at the last.
outside_clip_unknowns: What the person is doing with the wand/line before and after this excerpt, and whether they are actively producing the bubbles.
Whether the drifting large bubbles eventually pop or settle outside the frame.
The full duration and continuity of the bubble stream beyond these crop boundaries.
uncertain_details: Exact hand/arm motion of the distant person is too small to resolve.
Whether lateral bubble drift is due to wind or to bubbles passing the camera cannot be distinguished.
Apparent growth of the right-side cluster and the sand dome may combine translation with perspective change; not separable here.
